source: QA-defined from intake/INTAKE_CARD.md §2 artefact zones and gate-protocol standard masks BEFORE any deviation was computed

masks.name: M1 +X ear tip damage
masks.why: the +X ear tip of this specimen is damaged/torn (jagged outline x>20.4); CAD follows the undamaged -X ear by symmetry, so deviation there is specimen damage, not a modelling deviation

masks.name: M2 open boundary
masks.why: distance from CAD to a scan hole EDGE (unscanned tube-bore floor, port bores beyond t≈13-16, small loops) is not a surface deviation

masks.name: M3 skin normal
masks.why: a CAD point whose closest scan triangle disagrees in normal by >70 deg is an occluded/interior correspondence, not an outer-skin deviation
